text:
Priya (People Ops): Quick manager checklist for new hires: preboard tasks + a tight week0 agenda. Pls skim.

Alex (Hiring Manager): Looks good. Can we add who signs off on KMS & SSO? Also need 3 clear week1 deliverables.

Priya (People Ops): KMS/SSO approvals: Sam (IT) / security lead. Week1 deliverables suggestion: 1) dev env running (48h), 2) first PR opened, 3) 10-15m intro at team sync.

Sam (IT): I'll handle imaging + access. Timeline: order D-3, image D-1, provision D0-AM. Loaner available via #it-ops if shipping delayed. Typical commands we run: `gh invite --team eng lina@redwood.ai`, `mdm enroll --serial S/N`.

Jordan (Eng Manager): Proposed week0 schedule: Day0 AM welcome + accounts check, Day0 PM clone & smoke build, Day1 env + tests, Day2 pair on small task, Day3 arch walkthrough, Day4 PR review + team intro. Owners: Alex (context), Jordan (mentor), Sam (access), Priya (admin).

Priya (People Ops): Preboard manager checklist: confirm signed forms, equipment ETA, calendar placeholders (1:1 + mentor + 30/60/90), draft public announcement.

Alex (Hiring Manager): I'll assign Maria as buddy and Jordan as tech mentor. Lina, do 9:30 PT standups work?

Lina (New Hire): 9:30 PT works. Quick ask: where are core onboarding docs and can I get the 30/60/90 template early?

Sam (IT): Canonical docs: Confluence https://confluence.redwood.ai/eng/onboarding and handbook repo https://github.com/redwood-inference/handbook. GitHub access same-day usually when added to team; if blocked ping me with repo path.

Priya (People Ops): Sending 30/60/90 editable link to manager + new hire via DM. Manager tip in runbook: keep week0 timeboxed, favor short demos over long reading, schedule small wins.

onboard-bot: Reminder set -> post welcome in #general on 2026-06-01T09:00:00Z

Alex (Hiring Manager): Final owners: Hardware & imaging: Sam; Accounts & SSO: Sam; Forms & benefits: Priya; Role intro: Alex; Mentorship: Jordan; Buddy: Maria. I'll post announcement Monday once accounts confirmed.

Lina (New Hire): Thanks team, excited to join!
